# Workday RaaS

Run web-service-enabled Workday Reports as a Service (RaaS) reports with a dedicated least-privilege Workday account.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/workday-raas/.

## Actions

- **Get Latest Stock Grant** (read-only): Retrieve sensitive compensation data from an authorized tenant-defined Workday RaaS stock-grant report and return its unique latest row by…
